metadata.description: Runs the repo's existing `test:build-tools` suite (root package.json - reused verbatim, never forked) so the build/release-tooling specs, including the release pipeline's own, are covered by `nx affected -t test`. This project exists only to give the package.json-less `tools/nx-plugins/` tree a first-class nx identity: the six `@adhd/nx-*` sub-packages under it are separate workspace projects by longest-root-prefix, so the umbrella declares them as `implicitDependencies` to become affected whenever the build tooling changes. CACHED (cache-dag item 1): the suite validates repo-wide build/release wiring, so its `inputs` are the honest, audited read set (measured by an fs/child_process read-trace of a full `pnpm run test:build-tools` run): tools/**, .githooks/**, .github/**, root wiring files (nx.json, package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, pnpm-lock.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, published-state.json, .npmrc), every project's project.json/package.json/tsconfig*/vite.config*/executors.json/schema.json, every spec/test/e2e file in the workspace (lane-reachability walks them), the few docs files specs read, agent-core-env (a spec runs a nested `nx run agent-core-env:test`), toolchain versions, the git facts the specs read (history depth, shallow clone, lane-gate/.github clean vs HEAD, global git config) and the env vars the build tooling reads. Deliberately has no cross-target `dependsOn`: the umbrella is package.json-less, so the `lint`/`sync-deps-check` targets that targetDefaults expect do not exist here. NOTE: `.nxignore` hides docs/ and .claude/ from nx's file hasher entirely (explicit globs there match nothing), so the docs/.claude files the specs read are hashed by the `git hash-object` runtime input instead.

inputs.runtime: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- docs/PIPELINE.md docs/contributing/conventions/worktree-workflow.md docs/plan/backlog-completion/HANDOFF.md docs/plan/backlog-completion/TASKS.md .claude/skills/backlog-remediation 'docs/*.spec.*' 'docs/*.test.*' 'docs/*.e2e.*' | sort -u | xargs git hash-object | shasum
